newsitem.title: INDIA: India firms face funding problems-L&T.
newsitem.headline: India firms face funding problems-L&T.

text.p: Several Indian firms continue to have problems funding new projects this financial year (Apr/Mar 1996/97), an official of Larsen & Toubro Ltd, India's leading engineering and construction group, told Reuters on Thursday.
"We are seeing some temporary delays in finalising contracts," Yeshwant Deosthalee, L&T's senior vice president (finance), told Reuters in an interview.
He said some L&T customers who had gone ahead with projects, had encountered gaps in funding. But this was true of the economy as a whole, Deosthalee added.
"Companies are finding problems in securing short-term funds," he said. "The situation is strange. Banks are saying credit offtake is poor, customers are saying banks are not giving funds."
Deosthalee said banks' funds were still expensive despite recent cuts in prime lending rates.
Effective interest rates on short-term loans are about 16.0-17.0 percent per annum, analysts said.
